verdict.rationale: iTerm2 ships a genuine Python scripting API for deep automation (custom triggers, status bar components, menu items) plus AppleScript support, and triggers can directly invoke Python scripts — this is corroborated by both first-party docs and independent hands-on praise calling it 'basically AppleScript... but not soul-crushing to write.' Missing for 10: no Lua support and no kitty-style 'kittens' plugin system, so the specific named languages aren't all covered, though the core capability (extend via a real scripting language) is clearly delivered.
